The new Facility includes ... secondary treatment facilities consisting of an activated sludge system with biological nutrient removal (BNR); ... BNR will be accomplished using sequenced aeration in a series of aeration tank compartments.

The influent pumps will be set at 0.9 mgd to ensure that the peak treatment capacity is never exceeded...

The new Facility also includes sludge handling and storage facilities that will consist of a belt filter press housed in an enclosed building and 6 bays of redundant dewatering facilities and storage.
Two of the storage bays will be outfitted with synthetic filter media to act as sludge drying beds for redundancy in operations.
The Discharger plans to land apply treated, dewatered sludge on-site and plans to enroll under the statewide biosolids general permit...
The new Facility will also include expanded storage ponds with a capacity of 70 million gallons...
The new Facility will also include ... disposal of disinfected secondary treated effluent on 84 acres of agricultural spray fields owned by the Discharger...

The new Facility will also include tertiary wastewater treatment facilities that will consist of coagulation, filtration, and ultraviolet (UV) light disinfection for reuse on 25 acres of urban landscape areas on the TRACEN property.
